card.name: Verbs before interaction outcome statements
card.fires_on: Small linking or helper words (either, were, had, was, be, whether, an) that sit right before the result of a drug interaction or test, often a 'no effect', 'not affected' or 'also negative' finding.

modes.label: Helper verb before a null finding
modes.description: A verb such as had, was or were comes just before 'no effect', 'not affected' or 'also negative'.
modes.example: Cimetidine (400 mg b.i.d.)<< had>> no effect on vardenafil bioavailability

modes.label: Linking word before an interaction outcome
modes.description: Either, whether, be or an comes just before a stated direction or type of interaction effect.
modes.example: Combined use of methylphenidate with risperidone when there is a change in dosage,<< whether>> an increase or decrease, of either or
